https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/football/.text:
Joey Barton has made a bizarre appeal to Just Stop Oil to intervene and stop controversial adult star Bonnie Blue.
Environmental campaigners Just Stop Oil made headlines on Monday by spray-painting the grave of Charles Darwin. Two arrests were made at Westminster Abbey for suspicion of causing criminal damage after the activists used chalk paint on the famous naturalist’s final resting place in an effort to draw attention to the climate crisis.
Their action came on the same day that OnlyFans content creator Bonnie Blue claimed to have broken a world record for the highest number of men slept within a day. The 25-year-old Brit said she had bedded 1,057 men in 12 hours – a claim that has gone viral and attracted a lot of criticism and disgust.
It has also caught the attention of former footballer, full-time social media troll and wanna-be podcaster Barton, who decided to share his barely comprehensible thoughts. The 42-year-old tried his best to write a gag, but succeeded only in drawing a confusing parallel between two topical but entirely unconnected events.
Barton wrote on X: “Can Just Stop please spray paint this Bonnie Blue’s f**** orange. She’s just been flattened by over a 1000 degenerates for content.
“That’s over a thousand johnnies all made of plastic! And a load of dirty b****** a***** going like a bees-wing, trying to shoot their bolt in the allotted 30 seconds.
“All of which contribute massively to the warming of the planet. Leave Charlie Darwin’s grave alone. It’s this dirty b**** you should be spraying.”
One of the Just Stop Oil activists who was arrested on Monday was Di Bligh, a 77-year-old former chief executive of Reading Council, who tried to explain her actions. “We've done this because there's no hope for the world, really,” she said. “We've done it on Darwin's grave specifically because he would be turning in that grave because of the sixth mass extinction taking place now.”
Meanwhile, in entirely different news, Bonnie Blue, whose real name is Tia Billinger, explained to her TikTok followers how her publicity stunt had worked. She thanked the "barely legal" participants as well as "all the husbands" who took part
She said she felt fine after the "sex marathon", adding: “It feels as if I've had a heavy day in the bedroom, which is exactly what I've had. I think if it continued how it did for the first three or four hours I would have struggled."
